schema.text: When you travel by car, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. by closing the windows
I take another route or travel at another time
I travel another way (e.g. by metro instead of by car)

en.#When you travel by car, what do you do: When you travel by car, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?
en.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: I notice it, but I don't change anything
en.#I take another route or travel at anoth: I take another route or travel at another time
en.#I protect myself, e.g. by closing the w: I protect myself, e.g. by closing the windows
en.#I travel another way (e.g. by metro ins: I travel another way (e.g. by metro instead of by car)

it.#When you travel by car, what do you do: Quando viaggi in auto, cosa fai quando l’aria è cattiva (gas di scarico, polvere, cattivi odori)?
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Prendo un altro percorso o mi sposto in un altro orario
it.#I protect myself, e.g. by closing the w: Mi proteggo, ad es. chiudendo i finestrini
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by metro ins: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in metro invece che in auto)

fr.#When you travel by car, what do you do: Lorsque vous vous déplacez en voiture, que faites-vous quand l’air est mauvais (gaz d’échappement, poussière, mauvaises odeurs) ?
fr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Je le remarque, mais je ne change rien
fr.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Je prends un autre itinéraire ou je me déplace à un autre moment
fr.#I protect myself, e.g. by closing the w: Je me protège, par ex. en fermant les vitres
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by metro ins: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en métro plutôt qu'en voiture)

de.#When you travel by car, what do you do: Was tun Sie bei Autofahrten, wenn die Luft schlecht ist (Abgase, Staub, schlechte Gerüche)?
de.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Ich merke es, ändere aber nichts
de.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Ich nehme eine andere Route oder fahre zu einer anderen Zeit
de.#I protect myself, e.g. by closing the w: Ich schütze mich, z. B. mit geschlossenen Fenstern
de.#I travel another way (e.g. by metro ins: Ich nutze ein anderes Verkehrsmittel (z. B. U-Bahn statt Auto)

tr.#When you travel by car, what do you do: Arabayla yolculuk ederken hava kötü olduğunda (egzoz dumanı, toz, kötü kokular) ne yaparsınız?
tr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Fark ederim ama hiçbir şeyi değiştirmem
tr.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Başka bir güzergâh seçerim veya başka bir saatte yolculuk ederim
tr.#I travel another way (e.g. by metro ins: Başka bir şekilde giderim (örn. otomobil yerine metroyla)

fa.#When you travel by car, what do you do: هنگام سفر با خودرو، وقتی هوا آلوده است (دود اگزوز، گردوغبار، بوی بد) چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#Nothing, it doesn't affect me: هیچ کاری، بر من اثری ندارد
fa.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: متوجه می‌شوم، اما چیزی را تغییر نمی‌دهم
fa.#I take another route or travel at anoth: مسیر دیگری می‌روم یا در زمان دیگری سفر می‌کنم
fa.#I protect myself, e.g. by closing the w: از خودم محافظت می‌کنم، مثلاً با بستن شیشه‌ها
fa.#I travel another way (e.g. by metro ins: با روش دیگری سفر می‌کنم (مثلاً با مترو به جای خودرو)

hu.#When you travel by car, what do you do: Autós utazás közben mit tesz, ha rossz a levegő (kipufogógáz, por, kellemetlen szagok)?
hu.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Más útvonalat választok, vagy más időpontban utazom
hu.#I travel another way (e.g. by metro ins: Más módon utazom (pl. metróval autó helyett)

ar.#When you travel by car, what do you do: عند التنقل بالسيارة، ما تصرّفك عندما يكون الهواء سيئًا (عوادم المركبات أو الغبار أو الروائح الكريهة)؟
ar.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: ألاحظ ذلك، لكنني لا أغيّر شيئًا
ar.#I take another route or travel at anoth: أسلك طريقًا آخر أو أتنقل في وقت آخر
ar.#I travel another way (e.g. by metro ins: أتنقل بطريقة أخرى (مثلًا بالمترو بدل السيارة)
